I told Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message that the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

That comes from a note Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025. Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 on the morning shift: the same trailer showed up twice because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch then added him by hand. Marcus is in that channel, so he could see it himself.

I also told him Dana owns the account, so she's the internal person to check with.

One thing to flag: I said Thea is "listed" as QFL's main contact, and that line came from the account page in gbrain, which Marcus may not be able to open. Contacts count as operational facts and Marcus is on the North team, so sharing it is within the rules. I didn't pass on any money terms or contract figures.
